period.label: Month
period.notCalculated: Not calculated yet. Figures appear after the next calculation.

statement.title: Commission statement
statement.intro: Commission is earned when an invoice is paid, on the amount excluding VAT, at the rate in force that day.
statement.noEmployee: Your account is not linked to an employee record, so you have no statement. Open the team summary instead.
statement.empty: No commission lines in this month.
statement.rules: Returns within 90 days of collection, reversed allocations and bounced payments reduce the month they happen in. A closed month never changes.

team.title: Team commission
team.intro: Commission per employee for the month. Open a name to see the statement.
team.empty: No commission in this month for the employees you can see.

periods.title: Commission periods
periods.intro: Each month is recalculated every night and closes on day 6 of the next month. A closed month is final.
periods.closeHint: Closing runs the final calculation and freezes the month. Later returns and bounced payments go to the month they happen in.
periods.confirmClose: I checked the {month} statements and want to close the month.

adjust.title: Commission adjustments
adjust.intro: A bonus, clawback or correction for one employee and month. Each one needs approval before it counts.
adjust.amountPositive: A bonus must be a positive amount with at most 2 decimals.
adjust.amountNegative: A clawback must be a negative amount with at most 2 decimals.
adjust.amountInvalid: Enter a non-zero amount with at most 2 decimals.
adjust.reasonHint: Shown on the employee's statement and to the approver.
adjust.noEmployees: There is no employee you can adjust.
adjust.noOpenMonth: There is no open month to adjust.

messages.pending: Sent for approval. It counts once approved.
messages.posted: The adjustment is on the statement.

errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.VALIDATION: Some values are not valid. Check the form and try again.
errors.INVALID_STATE: This month cannot be changed in its current state.
errors.PERIOD_CLOSED: This month is closed. Use an open month.
errors.PERIOD_NOT_ENDED: A month can be closed only after it has ended.
errors.PREVIOUS_PERIOD_OPEN: Close the earlier open month first.
errors.SELF_ADJUSTMENT: You cannot adjust your own commission.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This form was already used for another request. Reload the page.
errors.CONFLICT: Someone changed this at the same time. Reload and try again.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: The service is not reachable. Check the connection and try again.
